summary: @servicetitan/marketing-route preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads a Bun runtime binary from GitHub releases and then uses `execFileSync` to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` under that runtime, with the package directory as cwd. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line, string-array-shuffle-obfuscated bundle (rotator `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9`, large mixed numeric/string table) whose contents cannot be reviewed without decoding. The declared purpose of the package ("Marketing route package for global navigations") has no functional need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque native-execution payload. Installing the package on a default `npm install` automatically fetches the Bun interpreter and hands it the obfuscated blob, executing attacker-supplied code on the installer's machine outside Node-based observability.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
